title: Tiny ok for bread bags to replace twist ties...
text: Tiny ok for bread bags to replace twist ties.... These are ok clips but are best only for soft plastic bags like for bread just to replace the twist ties and allow fast access to what you have in the bag.  Do not work well on chip bags they slip off too easily...
